note: Claims-first register for Spec 050 (design D-13, PR #195 packet; consumer of Asset A), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign approved by the owner as written on 2026-10-21. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-ASSET-A-CONTRACT (Asset A, when built and frozen under Spec 045, conforms to the contract of Spec 045 section 2 that this spec consumes), ASM-PINNED-CORPUS (the pinned corpus layer of spec section 6 is the corpus of record for every count), ASM-POSITIONAL-FRAMEWORK (the pinned positional record and Phase-43 framework define final position as spec section 4.1 states), ASM-CROSSWALK-KEYS (the pinned sign_crosswalk_master defines the sign identity space Asset A and this spec share), ASM-PUBLISHED-ID-LAYER (a depicted-kind label is a published identification, not ground truth about the sign), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (asset, integrity, census, and freeze-order gates precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited). FREEZE (2026-10-21): before the hooks, the freeze decisions were applied as recorded in adjudication.md section 7 — in the register, the pin-timing ruling DD-050-11 restated F050-C06 (the freeze record quotes Spec 045's freeze digest 5d8254ddc03045b68a0819f870fc9ccc1b9848a58fef3862dae3e4ca21b43f0a as contract anchor and fixes specs/045-hunt-depicted-kinds/asset-a/asset-a-freeze.json as the pin source; gate 0.1 asserts the digest at execution step 0). The AEE lifecycle hooks then ran at the freeze gate under aee 1.5.0 (DD-050-9 reading). Pre-round: the 0.5-draft register could not load in the engine (draft evidence kinds and source qualities are not engine values). A test load with the kind/quality remap alone returned 54 failure modes (25 shared-evidence independence records, 14 irreducibility challenges, 15 draft-cap records) and no claim below the 0.70 threshold (minimum propagated 0.72). Recovery to 0.6-draft (kind and quality remap; independent_of declarations within multi-item claims) left 29 failure modes (14 irreducibility, 15 draft-cap). Recovery to 0.7-draft (every challenged claim text restated as a single head proposition, carried clauses moved into boundaries verbatim-in-substance) left 17 failure modes (2 irreducibility — F050-C04, F050-C07 — and 15 draft-cap). Recovery to 0.8-draft (connective-free restatement of the C04 and C07 heads) surfaced one negation-conflict pair (C01/C04); boundary_confirmation records for that pair, C04's head restated under its own subject, and a further restatement of C04's head after a C04/C06 pair surfaced, left exactly 15 FR-2.3 draft-cap records at each of after_specify, after_plan, and after_tasks, with zero correctness failure modes and no claim below the 0.70 threshold (minimum propagated 0.72); the engine outcome word reads iterate solely from the draft-cap records. Full record in aee/freeze-aee-note.md.

claims.text: An outcome under Spec 050 states only whether the signs Asset A classes as sky_cycle are enriched in text-final position in the pinned corpus, under the pinned positional framework.
boundary: The scope is claim without_kings_or_conquests_the_indus_scr_ce9d98cc_manual_004's terminal-enrichment question, on the pinned corpus layer and framework of spec section 6. claims.text: The pooled final-position rate of Asset A's sky_cycle signs in the pinned corpus exceeds the pooled final-position rate of the frequency-matched comparison class of spec section 4.2 by an enrichment ratio of at least 1.5.
boundary: The SUPPORTED form of this hypothesis additionally requires Fisher's exact test at the 5% level, with at least half the class's occurrences coming from signs individually above the corpus-wide final-position rate (spec section 4.3). The hypothesis is about the frozen sky_cycle class, pooled as occurrences, on the pinned corpus under the pinned framework. It asserts nothing per sign (per-sign results are reported under F050-C13 and can disagree with the pooled direction), nothing about any contested or borderline subset except through the sensitivities of F050-C08, and nothing about meaning.
alternatives: the ratio lands at or below 1.0 (the falsifier, F050-C04)
the ratio lands between 1.0 and 1.5, or at or above 1.5 without the test or the half-of-occurrences condition (INCONCLUSIVE under F050-C11)
falsification_tests: run the section 4.3 primary: if the enrichment ratio is below 1.5, or the exact test fails at the 5% level, or the half-of-occurrences condition fails, this hypothesis is not supported

metadata.strongest_rival: the frequency confounder itself: a class of uncommon signs can show a high or low final rate for reasons of frequency alone, which is why the denominator is frequency-matched rather than corpus-wide
metadata.verdict_rule: supported for this hypothesis iff all three section 4.3 SUPPORTED conditions hold together on the primary population

claims.text: Text-final position under Spec 050 is the last sign of an inscription's recorded sequence in the pinned corpus.
boundary: Final position is as counted by the pinned positional framework. A sign's final-position rate is its final-position occurrences over its total occurrences, and a class's rate pools occurrences rather than averaging per-sign rates; this spec introduces no new length floor, segmentation rule, sign ordering, or re-typing. Final position is not the tripartite closing part, not the terminal-strong sign class, and not a suffix-like behaviour score; those are D-05's and D-08's objects. Any length or segmentation convention the pinned framework itself applies is part of that framework, is restated in the gate-0.5 reproduction record, and applies identically to both classes.
falsification_tests: gate 0.5 is the operational test: a framework application that cannot reproduce the pinned record's 805 / 2,267 formula count and 40 / 61 / 20 strong-sign classes is not the pinned framework, and the run stops INVALID before any ending quantity

metadata.strongest_rival: definition drift — an ending measure quietly redefined (a length floor added, a segmentation changed) between the design and the run, manufacturing or erasing an enrichment
metadata.verdict_rule: identity of the ending definition is judged by the gate-0.5 exact-reproduction standard, not by code inspection alone

claims.text: The primary denominator is the frequency-matched comparison class of spec section 4.2.
boundary: The comparison class is the non-celestial, non-contested signs whose total occurrence counts lie between the smallest and the largest total counts among the primary celestial members, inclusive. The corpus-wide final-position rate is published beside it as descriptive context and as the rate for the per-sign condition, never substituted as the primary denominator. The band rule is this draft's operational reading of the design's 'same frequency band' / 'signs of comparable frequency' (DD-050-2): it is derived from the class's own recorded counts at the census, before any final-position quantity exists, and no numeric band is invented at draft. Unidentified signs inside the band are comparison members, counted and flagged.
alternatives: the corpus-wide rate as the primary denominator (the falsifier's looser first phrasing; refused as primary because frequency confounding is the named confounder it would re-admit — it is retained exactly where the design uses it, in the per-sign condition)
falsification_tests: the gate-0.4 census must publish the band's endpoints, the comparison members, and their total occurrences before any final count; a primary ratio computed against any other denominator falsifies compliance

metadata.strongest_rival: denominator-shopping between the matched and corpus-wide rates once both are known
metadata.verdict_rule: the census is the judge: band, membership, and totals are recorded before positional quantities, and section 4.3's ratio names its denominator

claims.text: The headline verdict is assigned mechanically by spec section 4.3.
boundary: SUPPORTED holds iff the enrichment ratio is at least 1.5, Fisher's exact test passes at the 5% level, and the half-of-occurrences condition holds; NOT SUPPORTED holds iff the ratio is at or below 1.0; INCONCLUSIVE holds in every other adjudicated case; TOO THIN — the recorded form of INCONCLUSIVE — holds if the celestial or the comparison class totals fewer than 30 occurrences at gate 0.4, in which case no final-position rate is computed. These are design D-13's criteria, carried verbatim in their values (1.5, 1.0, the 5% level, the half-of-occurrences condition, the 30-occurrence floor). The exact test is Fisher's exact test, two-sided, on the pooled 2x2 table (DD-050-4). No threshold is adjusted for the class's size or for any observed quantity.
falsification_tests: the verdict assignment is mechanical from the recorded quantities and census; any verdict not following this rule from its run's numbers falsifies the outcome record

claims.text: Execution stops before any final-position quantity is computed on any step-0 gate failure named in spec section 3.
boundary: The gates are: Asset A unfrozen or its digest mismatching (gate 0.1), an input hash mismatching (0.2), a corpus sign lacking an Asset A row or a sky_cycle key failing to resolve in the crosswalk (0.3), the positional record's quantities not reproduced (0.5), or the freeze-order proof absent (0.6). Gate 0.4's census is totals-only and its failure class is TOO THIN, not INVALID. These are spec section 3's gates. Their failure classes are CLOSED AT STEP 0 (0.1), INVALID (0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6), and TOO THIN (0.4). No failure is repaired at run time; a repaired input or a different asset is a new freeze, not a resumed run.
